text: Executive in the two of Scotland. See Law _Index._ Exerction, in the French mutus; is uifed to denote the manner of finging, or of the performance of a long. "As to the manner of finging, called in France overs-tion, no nation may, with any probability disputes with the French. If the French, by their comments with the Italian hasn gained a bobier competition, the Italiana have made their advantage of the French, in learning of them a more polite, moving, and exqui-fine execution. St Bernardo
